gloss: to hurt; to injure; to damage

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {痛|いた}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to hurt; to injure (a body part)
definitions.explanation: To cause physical injury or pain to a part of the body, especially through strain or overuse.

definitions.gloss: to trouble; to worry; to agonize over
definitions.explanation: To cause mental or emotional distress. Used in the set expression 頭を痛める (to worry over something) and 心を痛める (to be pained by something).

⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧すぎて⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}め→痛む：03008_itamu⟧てしまった。
examples.english: I injured my knee from running too much.

notes:
USAGE:
An ichidan (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧) transitive verb. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the body part or abstract thing being hurt.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {痛|いた}める: to hurt, to injure (physical pain or emotional distress)
- ⟦{傷|いた}める→傷める：02098_itameru⟧: to damage, to wound, to spoil (physical damage to objects or food)
- ⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry (cooking)
All three are pronounced いためる but have different meanings and kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛|いた}める: to hurt one's back
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛|いた}める: to injure one's knee
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛|いた}める: to worry, to agonize
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛|いた}める: to be pained, to feel sorrow
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{痛|いた}める: to upset one's stomach (from stress)
